review_contract: This bounded batch combines exact-date ordered passenger calls, official company line scope, and the shipped current N02 snapshot. It asserts current_n02 identity and operator metadata only. It does not assert a rail-history id, a daily physical-line validity interval, solver completion, or complete route publication readiness.

new_sources.publisher: 国土交通省 国土数値情報
new_sources.title: 鉄道データ N02 令和7年版
new_sources.notes: The official catalog defines railway-line and operator fields. Canonical jp-* ids and endpoint membership are deterministic project packaging of the shipped snapshot. The snapshot supplies no per-line daily validity interval through 2026-09-30.

new_sources.publisher: 北海道旅客鉄道株式会社
new_sources.title: 営業エリア・JR北海道各線営業キロ数
new_sources.notes: The official company inventory lists 函館本線 函館–旭川 and 宗谷本線 旭川–稚内. It proves company line scope as of the displayed date, not an exact train path, a jp-* id, or daily line validity. N02 metadata uses 函館線 and 宗谷線.

new_sources.publisher: 東日本旅客鉄道株式会社
new_sources.title: 中央本線・篠ノ井線・信越本線に新型車両を投入します
new_sources.notes: The notice explicitly gives 篠ノ井線 塩尻–篠ノ井 and 信越本線 篠ノ井–長野. It establishes JR East line boundaries, not that Shinano 10 used them on a particular date, a jp-* id, or daily validity.

new_sources.publisher: 東海旅客鉄道株式会社
new_sources.title: 東海ななと巡る！橙色の在来線旅 中央本線 東濃・木曽おでかけ編
new_sources.notes: JR Central states that Limited Express Shinano links Nagoya and Nagano via the Chuo and Shinonoi lines. It supports service route scope, not the exact 2026-09-30 calls, the Shinonoi–Nagano physical name, a jp-* id, or daily validity.

new_sources.publisher: 九州旅客鉄道株式会社
new_sources.title: 路線別鉄道営業キロ数
new_sources.notes: The official company table gives endpoints for 鹿児島本線, 日豊本線, 長崎本線, 佐世保線, 篠栗線, and 筑豊本線. It proves company line scope as of the displayed date, not an exact train path, a jp-* id, or daily validity.

new_sources.publisher: 四国旅客鉄道株式会社
new_sources.title: JR四国 会社案内
new_sources.issue: Corporate profile downloaded from the official company-information page
new_sources.notes: The official company profile maps the JR Shikoku network and names 予讃線, 土讃線, and 高徳線. It supports company network scope, not an exact dated train path, a jp-* id, or daily validity.
